next.reason: The 2023 reference-modification format (§2023:8.4.3.3.2) takes identifier-1 where 1985 had data-name-1, and an identifier may be qualified and subscripted. §2023:8.4.3.3.3 SR3 'Identifier-1 shall not be a reference-modification format identifier' excludes only what 1985's 'qualified or subscripted' also excluded. Function and method identifiers as the base are additions.
